name: Folate one-carbon and methionine cycle metabolism
rationale: Members cover folate/tetrahydrofolate interconversion, formate and methionine salvage/SAM metabolism and their inborn errors (MTR, MTRR, AHCY, MAT1A); the methionine/SAM arm separates it from folate-only C1, cobalamin C2, selenium C3 and choline/carnitine C4.

qualifier: DNA replication, transcription and mRNA turnover
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and mRNA turnover
rationale: All members concern mtDNA maintenance, mitochondrial transcription and mitochondrial mRNA stability/decay, distinguishing it from confusables centred on mitochondrial translation or tRNA/rRNA modification.

name: Rho GTPase-driven stress fibers and cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members share actin stress fiber/cytoskeletal remodeling tied to matrix adhesion (fibronectin, syndecans, integrins); the ROCK/PAK Rho effector members distinguish it from MET/focal-adhesion and platelet integrin confusables.

name: Endothelial eNOS regulation and nitric oxide-cGMP signaling
rationale: Members cover eNOS activation and trafficking, NO synthase regulation and NO-cGMP signal transduction; the eNOS/endothelial focus separates it from renal cGMP, smooth muscle contraction and shear-stress confusables.

name: Spliceosomal splicing, snRNP biogenesis and mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members cover snRNA transcription and snRNP assembly, spliceosome-mediated splicing and its regulation, and mRNA/histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing; this distinguishes it from rRNA/Pol I-III, RNA decay and mRNA export confusables.

qualifier: regulation of fatty acid import and carnitine shuttle
name: Regulation of fatty acid import and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern control of fatty acid uptake and mitochondrial entry (carnitine shuttle, malonyl-CoA) and beta-oxidation regulation; regulatory/import members separate it from beta-oxidation step, carnitine transport and lipid droplet confusables.

qualifier: antioxidant, ER-stress, inflammatory and drug-resistance targets
name: NFE2L2 regulation of stress-response and detoxification genes
rationale: All members are NFE2L2 (NRF2) expression or its target-gene programs (antioxidant/detox, ER stress, inflammation, MDR); distinct from BACH1/HMOX1, FOXO, ROS detoxification and NFE2L2 metabolic-gene confusables.

qualifier: choline, carnitine, creatine and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Choline, carnitine, creatine and lysophospholipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover choline metabolism/transport, carnitine synthesis, creatine metabolism and LPC/LPE glycerophospholipid hydrolysis; the lysophospholipid and creatine members distinguish it from SAM-centred and acetylcholine/ATP-transport confusables.

name: Matrix metalloproteinase-mediated collagen and elastin degradation
rationale: Members concern MMP activation/secretion and collagen and elastin catabolism, distinguishing it from fibrinolysis/coagulation, ECM assembly and ECM gene-module confusables.

name: Phosphate homeostasis in ectopic calcification and enamel mineralization
rationale: Members cover phosphate transport/homeostasis, PTH response and mineralization disorders (SLC20A2 brain calcification, ABCC6 PXE, SLC24A4 enamel); these separate it from SLC34/FGF23-Klotho and dentinogenesis confusables.

qualifier: scrambling, blebbing and mechanical stress repair
name: Phospholipid flipping/scrambling and membrane mechanical stress response
rationale: Members share aminophospholipid flippase/scramblase activity together with membrane blebbing, repair, cell volume and pressure responses, distinguishing it from ER lipid transfer, apical trafficking and apoptotic PS-clearance confusables.

qualifier: regulated protein import/export and ribosomal subunit export
name: Regulated nuclear protein import/export and ribosomal subunit export
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore traffic of proteins, ribosomal subunits and Rev cargo plus its regulation; protein import/export regulation distinguishes it from mRNA export, NPC assembly, SUMOylation and inositol phosphate transport confusables.

name: HIV entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and Env/Vpu
rationale: Members are early HIV life-cycle steps (binding/entry, uncoating, minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis) and Env/Vpu functions; distinct from other-virus, integration/latency and Nef downregulation confusables.

name: Protein lipidation and lipidated Wnt/Hedgehog ligand secretion
rationale: Members cover S-palmitoylation, depalmitoylation, prenylation (RAS/RAB) and lipid-dependent Wnt and Hedgehog ligand processing and release, distinguishing it from Hh/Wnt signal reception, delipidation and phospholipid transfer confusables.

name: IL-12 family, IL-10 and interferon-gamma signaling
rationale: Members are IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10 and type II interferon signaling; these distinguish it from type I/III interferon, IL-37 and common gamma-chain/IL-6 confusables.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cell size and muscle atrophy
rationale: Members concern calcineurin/NFAT and calcium signaling regulating cell size, dendrite morphogenesis and muscle atrophy/inactivity, distinct from phosphatase regulation, myogenesis/contraction and hypertrophy confusables.

name: Angiotensin signaling in renal control of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members cover angiotensin signaling and renal renin-angiotensin regulation of blood volume, glomerular filtration and arterial pressure, distinct from angiotensin metabolism and aldosterone/sodium transport confusables.

qualifier: endogenous peptide loading in the ER
name: MHC class I loading of endogenous peptides in ER
rationale: Members concern cytosol-to-ER peptide transport and assembly of endogenous peptides with MHC class I, distinct from proteasome, cross-presentation and viral MHC downregulation confusables.

qualifier: CYP oxidation and conjugation of dietary toxins and drugs
name: Xenobiotic and dietary toxin biotransformation and conjugation
rationale: Members cover CYP-mediated oxidation (CYP2E1, CYP1A2), conjugation (sulfonation, acetylation, methylation) and detoxification of drugs, mycotoxins and plant compounds, distinct from steroid/FMO/thiopurine-focused confusables.

qualifier: beta-catenin destruction complex and its cancer mutants
name: Beta-catenin destruction complex phosphorylation and its oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin phosphorylation by the destruction complex and APC, AXIN, AMER1, GSK3B and CTNNB1 mutants that escape it; distinct from wider Wnt pathway regulation and Notch confusables.

qualifier: eIF2alpha-kinase translational control with PERK/IRE1 UPR
name: Integrated stress response and PERK/IRE1 unfolded protein response
rationale: Members cover eIF2alpha kinase (PERK, HRI, GCN2) translational control, mitochondrial stress and IRE1/XBP1/ATF4 UPR outputs, distinguished from ATF6/CREB3-centred UPR confusables.

name: Integrin activation in leukocyte cell-cell adhesion and migration
rationale: Members share integrin-mediated and PECAM1 leukocyte cell-cell adhesion and migration; integrin activation distinguishes it from immunological synapse, Rap1 signaling and extravasation confusables.

name: Cholinergic neuromuscular transmission and clostridial neurotoxin blockade
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine synthesis, choline uptake, release, nicotinic receptors and the botulinum/tetanus toxins that block release, distinct from GABA/glutamate/glycine and NMJ structural confusables.

qualifier: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 to STAT5
name: Hematopoietic EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members share hematopoietic receptor signaling to STAT5, PI3K and RAS via EPO, TPO, IL-3, IL-5 and FLT3 (incl. oncogenic fusions); distinct from PDGFRA, FLT3 drug-resistance and IL-2/7/9 confusables.

name: Leukotriene B4 catabolism
rationale: All three members concern catabolic inactivation of leukotriene B4/icosanoids, distinct from leukotriene synthesis/signaling, lipoxin and P450 eicosanoid confusables.
